questions.question: You are finding 46 - 28. You jumped 2, then 10, then 6. Add the jumps. What is 46 - 28?
questions.explain: Add your jumps: 2 + 10 + 6 = 18. The difference is the total of all the jumps, not a number you pass on the line.

questions.question: You are finding 72 - 45. You jumped 5, then 20, then 2. Add the jumps. What is 72 - 45?
questions.explain: Add all the jumps: 5 + 20 + 2 = 27. The answer is how far you jumped in total, not the number you started or ended at.

questions.question: You are finding 62 - 34. You jumped 6, then 20, then 2. Add the jumps. What is 62 - 34?
questions.explain: Add the jumps: 6 + 20 + 2 = 28. You add up all the jumps together to get the difference, not just one number.

questions.question: You are finding 85 - 57. You jumped 3, then 20, then 5. Add the jumps. What is 85 - 57?
questions.explain: Add the jumps: 3 + 20 + 5 = 28. The difference is the total distance you jumped, not a number you pass along the way.

questions.question: You want to find 56 - 29. You round 29 up to 30 (that is 1 more). You do 56 - 30 = 26. What do you do next?
questions.explain: You made 29 bigger by 1, so you took away 1 too many. Add that 1 back to get 27. Watch out for taking away instead of adding back.

questions.question: You want to find 83 - 35. You break 35 into 30 and 5. You do 83 - 30 = 53. Now do 53 - 5. What is the answer?
questions.explain: After taking away 30, you still take away 5. 53 - 5 = 48. The trap is stopping at 53 and forgetting the last part.

questions.question: You want to find 47 - 28. Which first jump on the number line makes sense?
questions.explain: You jump forward from the smaller number to the next ten. 28 to 30 is the first step. Jumping backwards or making one giant jump skips the strategy.

questions.question: You want to find 74 - 36. You make 36 into 40. 74 - 40 = 34. Remember to fix it. What is 74 - 36?
questions.explain: You made 36 bigger by 4, so you subtracted 4 too many. Add 4 back: 34 + 4 = 38. The trap is taking away instead of adding back.

questions.question: Tom has 91 marbles. He gives 34 to Anna, then 15 to Ben. How many marbles does Tom have left?
questions.explain: 91 - 34 = 57, then 57 - 15 = 42. The trap is stopping after the first take-away and forgetting Ben gets some too.

questions.question: You are finding 82 - a number. You start at that number, jump to 50 (3), jump to 80 (30), jump to 82 (2). The total is 35. What number did you start at?
questions.explain: The starting number is 82 - 35 = 47. Check it: 47 to 50 is 3, 50 to 80 is 30, 80 to 82 is 2. Total is 35.

questions.question: You want to find 95 - 47. You make 47 into 50 (that is 3 more). 95 - 50 = 45. Now fix it. What is 95 - 47?
questions.explain: You made 47 bigger by 3, so you subtracted 3 too many. Add 3 back: 45 + 3 = 48. The trap is taking away 3 instead of adding it back.

questions.question: Maya finds 64 - 27. She does 64 - 30 = 34, then 34 - 3 = 31. What went wrong?
options: She picked the wrong friendly number
She went the wrong way on the line
She added the two numbers together
She took away 3 instead of adding 3
questions.explain: She made 27 into 30, which is 3 more. So she took 3 too many away. She needed to add 3 back, not take it away.
